body: Tabs w/o content are OK if you plan filling these with JS so fixes are welcome.
thought this was fixed by e54b9c6fb73dcd72df99b229c044b125efecbed9 ...

No, it wasn't. When you don't set `content` you won't get here:
https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/extensions/bootstrap/Tabs.php#L159
And the you'll call undefined variable `$header` here:
https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/extensions/bootstrap/Tabs.php#L173
